title: lumi just got an update
items: **Forgot your password?** There's a reset link on the login screen now — we'll email you a one-time link to set a new one.
**Cleaner names:** usernames and display names can no longer be slurs or swears.

title: lumi just got an update
items: **Official lumi DMs:** news about updates, your account and your communities now shows up right here
**Volume and mute for anyone in a call:** right-click someone to turn them up to 200%, down, or mute them just for you
**Stream sound:** share a browser tab with its sound, and give each stream its own volume or mute it
**Close DM:** right-click a chat to hide it until someone messages again
**Faster pictures:** new profile pictures and banners show up instantly
**Safer communities:** swears and slurs are blocked in community and room names
